dataset.source: UCI Statlog German Credit, dataset 144 (Germany, 1990s vintage)
dataset.population_note: A different population and era from the Taiwan 2005 portfolio in results.json. These numbers describe German Credit only and must never be quoted as Taiwan results.

method: Same approach as the main pipeline: logistic regression and gradient boosting, median imputation, scaling, one-hot encoding, stratified split, configured seed and test size. Behavioural-style engineered features: amount_per_month, instalment_burden, amount_per_credit (the German schema has no payment-history panel).

transportability.reading: The like-for-like gap compares gradient boosting on both datasets. On German Credit the logistic baseline edges out gradient boosting, the classic small-sample result: 1,000 accounts do not feed a boosting model the way 30,000 do, and German Credit has no payment-history panel, so its confidence intervals are wide; see results/rigor.json.
